Third-party assets vendored so the console works without a CDN:

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `chartjs/chart.umd.min.js` | Chart.js 4.4.1 (npm `chart.js`) | MIT (`chartjs/LICENSE.md`) |
| `leaflet/*` | Leaflet 1.9.4 (npm `leaflet`) | BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet/LICENSE`) |
| `uk-outline.geojson` | UK + Ireland from Natural Earth 1:50m via npm `world-atlas@2` | Natural Earth: public domain; world-atlas: ISC (`uk-outline.LICENSE`) |
